mcp_tools.name: electrical_machinery_engineering_check
mcp_tools.title: Electrical machinery engineering check
mcp_tools.description: Submit a machinery engineering evidence manifest (duty, sizing, specification, acceptance tests, failure analysis, trending, records and safety); get a deterministic SOUND / NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections (duty, sizing, specification, acceptance tests, failure analysis, trending, records and safety), including computed worst-case-vs-rating and starting-current-vs-supply checks, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The machinery engineering evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

duty.description: Duty evidence (torque profile, starts/hour, ambient, altitude, worst case).

sizing.description: Sizing evidence (worst-case vs rating, service factor, starting current vs supply, efficiency at actual load).

specification.description: Specification evidence (type, insulation class, enclosure, bearings, heaters, RTDs, vibration limits, standards).

tests.description: Acceptance-test evidence (criteria, IR/PI/DAR, winding balance, surge, runs, units, calibration).

failure.description: Failure-analysis evidence (investigation gate, timeline, operating history, typical modes).

records.description: Records and red-line evidence (nameplate verification, re-energize rule, anomalies, records, deviations).
